proposals.title: Automated Invoice Generation on Job Completion
proposals.today: First one of 8 people (Ben, Ryan and others) does 'complete job in jobs'; then Emma does 'create invoice in accounts'. This happens about 292 times a month.
proposals.trigger: A field worker marks a job as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system.
Extract job details, customer information, and line items from the completed job.
Draft a new invoice in the accounts system using the extracted details.
Send the drafted invoice to Emma for review and approval.
ai_help: Extracts job details and line items to automatically draft the correct invoice in the accounts system.
human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice in the accounts system before it is sent to the customer.
proposals.risk_reason: Incorrect invoice amounts or details could lead to billing errors and customer dissatisfaction.
notes: ai_help given as text, read as a list
human_approval given as text, read as a list

proposals.title: Automate CRM Lead Creation from Quote Request Emails
proposals.today: Claire receives an email like “New quote request: Shower mixer replacement - Mangere Bridge” and then types it into crm (create lead) by hand, about 35 times a month.
proposals.trigger: A new quote request email is received from a potential customer.
steps: Receive the incoming quote request email.
Extract the customer details, job description, and location using AI.
Check if a lead already exists in the CRM system.
Create a new lead in the CRM with the extracted information.

proposals.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, an incorrect lead is created in the CRM which can be easily edited or deleted by Claire.

proposals.title: Route each PO request through approval and into accounts automatically
proposals.today: First one of 8 people (Tom, Jack and others) emails “PO request [ref]: toilet suite”; then James emails “PO request [ref]: toilet suite - approval needed ([amount])”; then Sarah emails “PO request [ref]: toilet suite - approved”; then James does 'create purchase order in accounts'. This happens about 12 times a month.
proposals.trigger: A request email arrives (the first step today)
steps: Capture the item and its reference number
Check the details are complete (reference, amounts, customer) and fill in what is missing
Send the approver a message with Approve / Decline, then wait for the answer
Create the record in accounts automatically (today James does 'create purchase order in accounts' by hand)
Tell the person who started it what happened
ai_help: Pre-fill the details from the message or job notes
Flag anything that breaks the usual pattern
human_approval: The approver still decides Approve or Decline, as today; nothing is ordered without it
proposals.risk_reason: it commits money: a person approves each one today and must keep approving

proposals.title: Create the jobs record from each ticket automatically

proposals.trigger: A new helpdesk ticket like “Move my plumbing appointment” is created
steps: Pick out only the tickets that match this pattern (sender and subject)
Extract the details Claire currently re-types for 'reschedule booking'
Show Claire the drafted record to approve (one click) before it is saved
Create the 'reschedule booking' record in jobs through its API
Link the new record back to the original ticket and log it
ai_help: Read the ticket and extract the fields, with a confidence score
Send anything unclear or unusual to a person instead of guessing
human_approval: Claire approves each item before anything is saved or sent
proposals.risk_reason: it changes jobs records that customers rely on
